answer: For agents estimating nectar yield in a meadow, ration subsidized requests by certified hardware. A secure kernel holds a nonexportable device key and derives one service-specific identifier per epoch. The server pools every agent on that device under one quota; reinstalling software preserves the identifier. Extra logins add no allowance. A Sybil farmer must buy or rent more genuine devices. Keep each epoch's subsidy below the cost of renting a device for that epoch. This assumes unforgeable certificates and keys that cannot be extracted.
